annotations.title: Benchmark and lowest marketplace prices for a county

description: Monthly premiums before any credit from CMS's plan file for a county in a HealthCare.gov state: the benchmark (second-lowest-cost silver) and the lowest bronze, silver and gold plan for a 40-year-old non-smoker, number of insurers and plans, and the same prices age-rated for the ages you give. Omit county for the state's range (median, lowest and highest benchmark).

ages.description: Optional ages of everyone on the plan, e.g. [62, 60], to price the household instead of one 40-year-old.

county.description: County name (e.g. "Harris" or "Harris County") or 5-digit county FIPS code.

state.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. TX, CA, DC) or full state name.

name: get_county_plan_prices
title: Benchmark and lowest marketplace prices for a county
